title: Child Game Purchase Alert
scenario: A text says your child bought game credits and you must click to cancel.

answers.A: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.B: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.C: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.
answers.D: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.

explanation: Child Game Purchase Alert: the trap is to make borrowed authority feel safer than checking. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Check purchases inside the official app store account.
